'''Delta Squadron''' was a [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defender]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It helped defend the [[XQ6 Platform|platform]] ''[[Research]]'' from the forces of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]] at the [[defense of Research]].
